notes: 'the Keeper' correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (no Name atom), 'at midnight' stays a bare Time symbol with no tense atom (habitual/unmarked), and half_mark emits its head genus while correctly withholding the non-predicable modifier 'half'.
